records.text: Thomas Massie said at least 95 percent of the money spent against him came from the Israeli lobby, naming the Republican Jewish Coalition, AIPAC, Miriam Adelson, Paul Singer, and John Paulson as funders or proxies behind MAGA Kentucky
records.speaker: Thomas Massie

appearances.snippet: It's come from billionaires and 95% of it, at least 95% has come from the Israeli lobby. ... the RJC, which is the Republican Jewish Coalition, AIPAC, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee, Miriam Adelson, Paul Singer and John Paulson went together. They funded a PAC called MAGA Kentucky

verification.notes: The full Tucker Carlson interview directly records Massie saying at least 95 percent came from what he called the Israeli lobby and naming the Republican Jewish Coalition, AIPAC, Miriam Adelson, Paul Singer, and John Paulson. The result verifies the attribution; the 95 percent grouping is Massie own characterization rather than an audited FEC category.
